title: Lancement du portail national unique de l’éducation : Améliorer la qualité du système éducatif à travers des services numériques adoptés
why_not: The EDU-NIGER portal handed over on 14 October 2022 holds ministry documents, messaging and staff leave requests, not learner records. The LIRE project's SIGE is only said to be envisaged 'pour bientôt', by name, with nothing on what it will hold or who will enter it.
